name: Bodylock Passing

phases.name: Chest-to-Hip Connection
phases.description: Drive chest into hip, lock hands low around the waist to prevent hip escape.

phases.name: Head Offset
phases.description: Position head to one side to block shoulder crunch and frames.

phases.name: Kill the Hooks
phases.description: Smash butterfly hooks flat with chest pressure before clearing the knee line.

phases.name: Clear Knee Line
phases.description: Step the trapped leg back while maintaining chest-to-hip pressure.

phases.name: Stabilize Side Control
phases.description: Once past, transition to side control pin immediately.

systemLogic.corePrinciple: Chest glued to hips + hands locked low + head offset = no space for hooks, no hip escape.

decisionTree.action: Drive head to the opposite side, re-establish chest contact
Drop hips, pin the hook knee, reset chest position
Follow hips, take the back instead of passing

exitStrategies: Take the back if opponent turns away
Switch to knee-cut pass if bodylock is stuck
Reset to headquarters if leg is trapped too long

keyCorrections.fix: Lock hands around the waist, below the belt line
Drive head to one side, pressing cheek to their chest

keyCorrections.issue: Standing up to clear the knee
keyCorrections.fix: Keep chest connected; step back, don't stand up

moneyDetails.oneLiner: Chest down, hands low, head off, knee clear.

safetyNotes: Watch your lower back — do not round it under pressure. Keep hips low to avoid being lifted.
fixItFast: Chest-to-hips → head offset → kill hooks → clear knee → pin
